verse.verse_1: O dear Prophet (Mohammed – peace and blessings be upon him), did you not see how did your Lord deal with the People of the Elephant?
verse.verse_2: Did He not put their scheme into ruin?
verse.verse_3: And send flocks of birds upon them,
verse.verse_4: Which hit them with stones of baked clay,
verse.verse_5: So He made them like the leftover devoured leaves of farms?
